NGA.note: Birth registration and NIN enrolment are offered side by side; no record exchange between the registers is stated.
Birth registration is named as a mobile unit service; no digital register is described.
No government payment to people is described.

Nothing on who operates the ID system.

facts.fact: On 11 November 2026 Minister Doro launched and handed ten Mobile One-Stop Shop vehicles to states with UNHCR and German support, to give displaced people birth registration, NIN enrolment, SIM registration, BVN, bank account opening and National Social Register enrolment.

systems.owner: Federal Ministry of Humanitarian Affairs and Poverty Reduction with UNHCR

NGA.note: Birth registration by mobile unit is named; no statement of digital entry at local registry offices.

facts.fact: Minister Doro said on 11 November 2026 that the new mobile units would give displaced and vulnerable people enrolment into the National Social Register.
